verses.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿١﴾ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ﴿٢﴾ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿٣﴾ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ﴿٤﴾ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ﴿٥﴾ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ﴿٦﴾ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ ﴿٧﴾
verses.translation_simplified: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Kind. Praise be to Allah, Lord of all the worlds. The Most Merciful, the Most Kind. Master of the Day of Judgment. It is You we worship and You we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path — the path of those You have blessed, not of those who earned Your anger, nor of those who went astray.
verses.primary_source: cross-confirmed across multiple independent sources (quran411.com, le-coran.com) — https://quran.com/al-fatihah
verses.confidence: verified — was stored as a single-verse excerpt mislabeled as the full 1:1-7 range; corrected to complete text 2026-08-05

verses.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
verses.translation_simplified: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.
verses.primary_source: cross-confirmed across multiple independent sources (Wikipedia's own Arabic-with-diacritics rendering, quran.com) — https://quran.com/en/al-ikhlas
verses.confidence: verified — was stored as a single-verse excerpt mislabeled as the full 112:1-4 range; corrected to complete text 2026-08-05 (verse 4 confirmed via the same primary source, not from memory)

verses.arabic_text: وَالْعَصْرِ ﴿١﴾ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ ﴿٣﴾
verses.translation_simplified: By time, indeed mankind is in loss, except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
verses.primary_source: cross-confirmed across multiple independent sources (quranwbw.com word-by-word, quran.com) — https://quran.com/al-asr
verses.confidence: verified — was stored as a partial 2-verse excerpt mislabeled as the full 103:1-3 range; corrected to complete text 2026-08-05

verses.translation_simplified: And when you have decided, put your trust in Allah.
verses.usage_context: After making a good decision, trusting Allah with the outcome — core tawakkul verse
verses.primary_source: en_Hisn_El_Muslim.pdf (Hisn al-Muslim / Fortress of the Muslim, Sa'id bin Ali bin Wahf Al-Qahtani), p.53, footnote 41, citing Surah Aal-e-Imran 3:159
verses.child_paraphrase: Once you've decided to do the right thing, trust Allah with what happens next.
verses.educational_interpretation: Applied in this repository's episodes to moments where a character has made a good choice and needs reassurance, not to decision-making itself.

verses.arabic_text: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
verses.translation_simplified: There is no god but You, glory be to You, I was truly wrong.
verses.usage_context: Prophet Yunus's dua when he was in the whale's stomach, trusting Allah in a hard moment
verses.primary_source: Stories Of The Prophets By Ibn Kathir.pdf, chapter 'Prophet Yunus (Jonah)', citing Surah Al-Anbiya 21:87

verses.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation_simplified: Indeed, Allah commands justice, grace, as well as generosity to close relatives. He forbids indecency, wickedness, and aggression. He instructs you so perhaps you will be mindful.
verses.translation_source: The Clear Quran, Dr. Mustafa Khattab (as displayed on quran.com)
verses.usage_context: The primary, most-cited verse commanding 'adl (justice/fairness) and ihsan (excellence/kindness) together — foundational for fairness-in-sharing episodes.
verses.cross_check_source_url: https://www.islamawakened.com/quran/16/90/ (independent translation compilation, Sahih International text matches in substance)

verses.arabic_text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.translation_simplified: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
verses.translation_source: Sahih International (as displayed on quran.com / corpus.quran.com)
verses.usage_context: The single most-cited Quran verse on patience — direct, foundational, short and memorable for young children.

verses.verse_numbers: 24:22 (full verse now stored; previously only the widely-quoted clause)
verses.arabic_text: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُولُو الْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوا أُولِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا وَلْيَصْفَحُوا ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.translation_simplified: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allah, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation_source: widely-quoted Sahih International rendering, confirmed across multiple sources
verses.usage_context: The clearest, most directly-on-topic forgiveness verse; historical context (revealed regarding Abu Bakr forgiving a relative, per Sahih al-Bukhari) makes it concrete and story-usable. Historical context: revealed after Abu Bakr swore to stop helping a relative (Mistah) who had wronged him; he restored the help immediately upon hearing this verse (Sahih al-Bukhari/Muslim) — real, citable, story-usable example of forgiveness in practice.
verses.cross_check_source_url: https://myislam.org/surah-nur/ayat-22/ (Sahih International + Yusuf Ali both independently confirm)
verses.confidence: verified — reverified 2026-08-05 directly against quran.com primary source (upgraded from secondary-source-only)

verses.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تُؤَدُّوا الْأَمَانَاتِ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا وَإِذَا حَكَمْتُم بَيْنَ النَّاسِ أَن تَحْكُمُوا بِالْعَدْلِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُم بِهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا
verses.translation_simplified: Indeed, Allah commands you to render trusts to their rightful owners; and when you judge between people, judge with fairness. What a noble commandment from Allah to you! Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
verses.translation_source: widely-confirmed rendering across multiple independent sources (Yusuf Ali paraphrase and Sahih International both converge on this meaning)
verses.usage_context: The direct, most-cited amanah verse — commands returning trusts, directly relevant to ep_honesty_wallet_assisted's core lesson. Historical context found: revealed regarding returning the key of the Ka'bah to its rightful keeper — real, story-adjacent precedent for 'returning what was entrusted to you', directly relevant to ep_honesty_wallet_assisted's theme.
verses.confidence: verified — reverified 2026-08-05 directly against quran.com primary source (upgraded from secondary-source-only)

verses.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
verses.translation_simplified: Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.
verses.translation_source: widely-confirmed rendering across multiple independent sources
verses.usage_context: Direct, real cleanliness verse pairing repentance with physical purification.
verses.confidence: verified — secondary-source Arabic, not primary-fetched from quran.com this pass

verses.arabic_text: مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ
verses.translation_simplified: The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed which grows seven ears; in every ear there are a hundred grains. Allah gives manifold increase to whom He wills.
verses.usage_context: The most-cited charity verse — the seven-ears-of-grain image is vivid and story-usable for children.
verses.confidence: verified — secondary-source Arabic, not primary-fetched this pass

verses.arabic_text: الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.translation_simplified: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds and establish prayer and give zakah will have their reward with their Lord, and there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
verses.translation_source: widely-confirmed Sahih International rendering, multiple independent sources
verses.usage_context: Direct, real prayer verse linking establishing prayer to peace and reward.
verses.confidence: verified — secondary-source Arabic, not primary-fetched this pass

verses.translation_simplified: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.
verses.usage_context: The Prophet's real words comforting Abu Bakr in the cave during the migration — short, memorable, story-usable, directly about courage in fear.
verses.confidence: verified — secondary-source Arabic (short phrase), not primary-fetched this pass

verses.arabic_text: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًۭا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًۭا
verses.translation_simplified: The [true] servants of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the foolish address them [improperly], they only respond with peace.
verses.translation_source: The Clear Quran, Dr. Mustafa Khattab (as displayed on quran.com)
verses.usage_context: Direct, primary-fetched verse — walking humbly + responding to rudeness with peace, both very actionable for children.
verses.confidence: verified — primary source directly fetched, full rigor matching qv_006/qv_007

verses.arabic_text: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
verses.translation_simplified: So, surely with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
verses.translation_source: quran.com rendering, cross-confirmed across many independent sources
verses.usage_context: One of the most famous, most repeated (twice in the same surah) verses on perseverance through hardship — short, memorable, ideal for children.
verses.confidence: verified — primary source directly fetched, full rigor

verses.arabic_text: وَاعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا ۖ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَبِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَالْجَارِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْجَارِ الْجُنُبِ وَالصَّاحِبِ بِالْجَنْبِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَنْ كَانَ مُخْتَالًا فَخُورًا
verses.translation_simplified: Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, and to parents do good, and to relatives, orphans, the needy, the near neighbor, the neighbor farther away, the companion at your side, the traveler, and those whom your right hands possess. Indeed, Allah does not like those who are self-deluding and boastful.
verses.translation_source: widely-confirmed rendering across multiple independent sources
verses.usage_context: Direct, comprehensive verse listing who deserves kindness — parents, relatives, neighbors, companions — real, primary community verse.
